Soon after his 17 birthday, Rick gets a job as a trainee chef at a well-known restaurant in
Melchester, 30 miles away.
Rick’s one-year contract with the restaurant promises him a basic wage and the opportunity to
train with a famous chef, although he may be required to work any hours and occasionally do
other kitchen duties.
There is no public transport available so Rick lies about his age in order to buy a new car on credit
from Topdeal Motors.
Rick gives up his job at the restaurant after only two months, complaining that all he has done is
wash dishes until 02:00. He says he has never worked with the famous chef and has received no
training.
Rick sells the car, having made no loan repayments. With the money he receives from the sale he
buys a motorbike and spends the remainder on a holiday with his friends.
Advise the restaurant and Topdeal Motors whether the contracts they have made with Rick are
enforceable and, if so, any remedies they might be granted. [25]
Iqbal wants to update his information technology (IT) system and meets with Jasper, the owner of
an IT solutions company.
Jasper tells Iqbal that, if given the contract, his company will provide ‘the latest software available’
and ‘24/7 customer support for the new system’. Jasper also suggests that Iqbal speaks to a
satisfied customer and gives him the contact details for Kate.
Iqbal meets Kate and is impressed with how complimentary she is about Jasper’s work. The next
day, on the basis of this and Jasper’s earlier promises, Iqbal makes a contract with Jasper to
update his IT system. The work is completed the following week.
A month later Iqbal is disappointed to discover that not every software program is the latest version.
When he tries to report problems with his new system, his calls are unanswered. He is annoyed to
see a picture of Kate with Jasper in the local newspaper alongside an article describing them as
‘owners of a successful IT solutions company’.
Advise Iqbal of any rights he may have against Jasper. [25]
Asha buys two tickets for the football cup final. She tells her brother Bilal that she will give him a
ticket if he will drive them to the game. He agrees. She later changes her mind, telling Bilal that
she is going to take her new boyfriend to the match instead.
Cushy Cars (CC) sponsors the cup final and in the month before the match, it runs a competition
to promote its business. The advertisement promises every customer who has a car serviced by
CC the chance to win a new car.
Asha is persuaded by the advertisement and pays to have her car serviced at her local CC
dealership and enters the competition. Six weeks later she is told that she has won but is shocked
to receive only a toy model of a car.
Advise Asha whether the agreement she has made with Bilal is enforceable and of any legal rights
against Cushy Cars. [25]
